wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.description: Something dead, walked by the fungus growing on it. It turns toward movement before it turns toward you.
wanderer.activity: Dusk to dawn, in the woods.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.description: Long-legged and low, three cold eyes. You see the eyes first, if you see anything.
behavior: Will not step into firelight or lamplight.
Bites, then backs away into the dark.

burrower.name: Burrower
burrower.description: A ringed grub beneath a low mound of turned earth. It feels footsteps. It does not feel someone walking softly.
behavior: Sneaking past does not wake it.
Sinks back if nothing is in reach.
burrower.activity: Night. The mounds stay by day, empty.

howler.name: Howler
howler.description: Very tall, very thin. It will not fight you. It will tell everything else where you are.
behavior: Its throat swells before the call: that is your moment.
Everything nearby comes to the call.
howler.activity: Night, at the edges of clearings.

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: A boulder that grew shoulders, a young tree rooted in its back. Walls only slow it down.
behavior: Very slow: you can always walk away.
Breaks through walls, doors and fences.
The swing is slow to land, so step back.

luminous.name: Luminous
luminous.description: A drifting bell of cold light over still water. It comes to lamps. It sheds spores if you stand with it quietly, and it stings if you do not.
behavior: Sneak close and wait, then shake spores free.
luminous.activity: Night, over water, more in fog.
